items.title: ChatGPT Dots are getting smarter, and you won't have to lift a finger
items.excerpt: OpenAI is making ChatGPT Dots smarter with GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Terra, allowing them to automatically pick the best AI model for each task.
items.rationale: Replaces the LG/SoundHound TV-ordering pick (little AI substance): a concrete new model update (GPT-6 Astra / GPT-6.1 Terra with automatic model routing) for ChatGPT Dots, from a fifth distinct outlet.
